summary: A Quote subscription on an NSE equity: AliceBlue's tk snapshot, then a tf delta that sends 0 for the unchanged open, become Quote frames; after the unsubscribe a tick still in flight reaches nobody.

notes: Both keep the last non-zero price when a delta sends 0 (aliceblue_adapter.py:663-690; brokers/aliceblue/streaming.rs FeedSnap::apply).
The login and its ck answer go through the desktop's loopback relay, with the REST socket session created first (a fake REST endpoint in tests/it/feed_corpus/aliceblue.rs).

deviations.reason: The web sends AliceBlue's feed time ft unchanged as ltt: epoch seconds, and a string ("1794302700"); the protocol's WebSocket timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md), so the unit is wrong, as for Dhan. The desktop sends the trade time in ms, as a number.

AliceBlue's tick carries last_quantity (ltq); the web's mapper never reads it (aliceblue_mapping.py:111-217), so its Quote leaves out a value the broker sent (lost data, lead ruling 2026-11-09). The desktop sends it.

AliceBlue's tick carries total_buy_quantity (tbq); the web's mapper never reads it (aliceblue_mapping.py:111-217), so its Quote leaves out a value the broker sent (lost data, lead ruling 2026-11-09). The desktop sends it.

AliceBlue's tick carries total_sell_quantity (tsq); the web's mapper never reads it (aliceblue_mapping.py:111-217), so its Quote leaves out a value the broker sent (lost data, lead ruling 2026-11-09). The desktop sends it.
